method: Bytes of each staged installer (stage-release-assets.sh output), checked by scripts/check-artifact-size.mjs in the desktop artifact smoke for the nightly and the release build.
ratchet: Baseline: the v2.5.0 release assets (2026-10-29), except the AppImages, which come from the dev build of 2026-10-30 (#2914 added the GStreamer video plugins after v2.5.0: x64 158.2 MB, arm64 151.8 MB), and the Windows installers and .deb packages, which come from the v2.9.0 dry run (2026-11-12; #3250 added the 885 KB Silero speech-detection model after v2.5.0: x64-setup 8.81 MB, arm64-setup 8.12 MB, amd64.deb 26.14 MB, arm64.deb 25.55 MB). Budget = baseline + 3 %, rounded up to the next 100 KB. A raise goes up by at most 3 % and says why in its PR; a PR that shrinks an installer lowers its budget. Phase Q4 goal: 20 % below the v2.5.0 size.
